subject: Vendor invoice path recommendation — Starlite onboarding
messages:
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@starlite.com>, ap@starlite.com
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 30 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Vendor onboarding: invoice submission options & sample headers

Hi Liam / Starlite AP team —

Welcome — excited to get Starlite set up. A couple of quick questions to make onboarding smooth:

1) Preferred invoice submission channel? We support:
   - Portal (recommended): secure upload, auto-ack, PO mapping
   - SMTP/email to ap@redwoodinvoice.com (fallback): we recommend a subject token and filename pattern to enable automated parsing
   - SFTP (rare): for high-volume suppliers

2) PO handling: Do you need Redwood to stamp our PO number onto the invoice, or will your system include the PO in the invoice lines? If you stamp, please indicate the preferred location.

3) Sample file/headers: attaching our onboarding form and a sample CSV header for compact multiline invoices. If you must send PDFs via email, please include a one-line plain-text summary in the body (PO#, invoice date, total, our PO line references).

Suggested subject lines (if you use SMTP):
   - REDWOOD-INVOICE | PO: 12345 | INV: 20260929.pdf
   - REDWOOD | STLR-PO-12345 | invoice_20260929.pdf

Attached: redwood_onboarding_form_v1.pdf (form to complete), sample header CSV.

Next steps: if portal is OK we’ll send an invite and provide a short onboarding checklist. If email is the only option, we’ll confirm the subject/filename pattern we need and a handful of sample files to validate parsing.

Thanks — Vanessa
Vanessa Ortiz
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
vanessa@redwood.com
Mobile: +1 415-555-0172

Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding: invoice submission options & sample headers

Thanks Vanessa — quick answers from our side.

Portal would be ideal from a control perspective, but our procurement platform still routes a lot of supplier email through a gating system that auto-tags and archives. That means we can do either: portal or email to ap@starlite.com. If email, we typically send PDF invoices and include PO numbers in the header of the PDF (not always in the filename).

Questions for Redwood:
- Can you support an email fallback where the parsing team also reads the first page text for PO extraction?
- If we must change anything, is adding the PO to the email subject feasible for our AP ops team to do automatically? We can adjust our outgoing template but need the exact example you want.

I’ve attached our vendor profile so you can see our current formatting. We can complete your onboarding form and run a sample file through a validation check.

Best,
Liam

Date: Thu, 01 Oct 2026 10:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding: invoice submission options & sample headers

Hi Liam / Vanessa —

Quick recommendation from procurement ops: portal-first, email-fallback with strict subject/filename conventions. If Starlite can add the PO to the subject we can automate parsing for ~95% of cases; otherwise we’ll do a hybrid approach where PDFs are OCRed and a small percentage are routed to manual review.

Needed for automated email ingestion:
- Subject token (exact format): REDWOOD|PO:<PO_NUMBER>|INV:<INVOICE_NUMBER>
- Filename pattern: STLR_<PO>_<INV>.pdf (underscore-delimited)
- Minimum CSV/CSV-like header if sending CSVs: invoice_number,invoice_date,po_number,amount,currency,line_description

Edge cases: multi-PO single invoice — include each PO in a delimited PO field (POs separated by ";"). If line-level PO mapping is required, include a "po_line_ref" column.

If portal is accepted, we will:
1) Send the portal invite and one-time onboarding checklist.
2) Run three sample invoices through our ingest pipeline (you can provide them).
3) Confirm PO stamping behavior (we can also stamp for you on request).

Attached a machine-friendly sample CSV and a short checklist for your ops team. Let us know which route you prefer and we’ll schedule a 20-min handoff with our onboarding engineer.

Jordan Blake
Senior Onboarding Manager, Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwood.com

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>

Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 02 Oct 2026 15:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Vendor invoice path recommendation — Starlite onboarding

Liam — thanks for the quick turn. Per Jordan’s note, portal is the lowest-effort for both sides and gives the cleanest SLA on acknowledgements. That said, we understand system constraints — we will accept SMTP/email to ap@starlite.com as a fallback provided the subject/filename pattern below is used for automation:

Required (for automated email ingestion):
• Subject: REDWOOD|PO:<PO_NUMBER>|INV:<INVOICE_NUMBER>
• Filename: STLR_<PO>_<INV>.pdf (or .csv/.xml for structured files)
• PDF requirement: first page must include the PO number textually (top-right or top-left)

If you prefer portal: we will send an invite today. Portal benefits: auto-ack, immediate PO-match feedback, and faster dispute resolution. Portal onboarding checklist link: https://drive.google.com/open?id=1a2b3c-onboarding-starlite

Next actions:
1) Liam: confirm portal vs email fallback by Tue 06 Oct.
2) Starlite: send 2 representative invoices (one single-PO PDF, one multi-PO CSV) to our validation inbox (validation@redwood.com) so ops can verify parsing.
3) Jordan/Marissa: schedule 20-min handoff with onboarding engineer and share final PO stamping preference.

If portal is OK, I’ll send the invite; if not, we’ll proceed with subject/filename enforcement and run the validation tests.

Thanks — looking forward to the go-live.

Vanessa Ortiz
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
vanessa@redwood.com
